title: pisum formosum
intro: Pisum formosum, commonly known as Taiwan pea or Formosa pea, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Pisum formosum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Additionally, studies have shown that Pisum formosum extracts exhibit potential therapeutic actions, including antiviral and antimicrobial activities, which may be beneficial in the treatment of various diseases.
